description: This file defines a static class 'ImageValidators' that provides methods for validating image files based on size and extension within the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: ImageValidators
classes.description: Contains static methods for image validation such as size and extension checks.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Validates if a byte array represents a valid image file based on size and extension.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is one of the allowed image formats (.jpg, .png, .gif, .jpeg).
